MPSC State Services Main Exam Postponed

The Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) has postponed the State Services Main Examination, originally scheduled for October 3. The MPSC State Services, Civil Engineering, and Group-B Main Exams 2026 have been deferred.
